theorems.name: Submission.dr_cc_lip_at_comp
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y Z : Type) [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y] [PseudoMetricSpace Z] (f : X → Y) (g : Y → Z) (A : Set X) (B : Set Y) (x : X) (K₁ K₂ : ℝ), 0 ≤ K₁ → 0 ≤ K₂ → MapsTo f A B → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' ∈ A, dist x' x < δ → dist (f x') (f x) ≤ (K₁ + ε) * dist x' x) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y' ∈ B, dist y' (f x) < δ → dist (g y') (g (f x)) ≤ (K₂ + ε) * dist y' (f x)) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' ∈ A, dist x' x < δ → dist (g (f x')) (g (f x)) ≤ (K₁ * K₂ + ε) * dist x' x
